about: Waterloo Region's four townships get Ontario's province-wide pack plus the Region of Waterloo's own programs. The Region's Ontario Renovates loan covers the whole Region; its fact sheet and form set lower tenant income limits for Wellesley and Wilmot.

grants.name: Region of Waterloo Ontario Renovates - Secondary Suites (forgivable loan)
grants.amount: Up to $25,000 per property, interest-free, forgiven evenly over 15 years (includes up to $5,000 for accessibility work that is a grant).

conditions.houseType: single family home (application lists single detached, semi-detached, townhouse)

conflict.source: Fact sheet dated Dec 2025 ('Province's Maximum House value')

rentCap.year: 2025 (application form v11 labels the same figures 2024)

tenantIncomeLimit.area: Remainder of Waterloo Region (includes Woolwich and North Dumfries)

grants.fitsPlansNote: The Region pitches it for an 'affordable in-law suite', but every occupant is treated as a tenant who must pass income verification and pay rent at or under the cap. Requires the owner to live in the house for 15 years.
grants.nextStep: Confirm zoning with the Township, then send the application to OntarioRenovates@regionofwaterloo.ca before any work starts.

grants.notes: Unverified: the house-value cap conflicts ($600,000 on the web page vs $505,469 in the Dec 2025 fact sheet). The fact sheet also says work must start within 90 days of approval (p. 4) and within 120 days (p. 7), and still prints an old 'deadline December 1, 2023'. The web page says applications are received on an ongoing basis but annual funding is limited; if the year's money is gone, eligible applicants go on a waitlist for the following year. The 2026 funding balance is not published.

apply.paidWhen: after the work is finished and inspected
bring: Written confirmation from the Township that your lot is zoned for a second unit
Photo ID, proof of status in Canada and proof of age for each owner
Your latest tax bill or MPAC assessment notice
Proof your mortgage, property tax and home insurance payments are up to date
Your mortgage balance, and your lender's OK for a second mortgage if the work costs more than $25,000

payout.title: send invoices and the occupancy permit
payout.detail: The Region inspects the work, then pays. It checks the tenant's income before the lease is signed.
bring: The tenant's income check and the signed lease

Wellesley.note: As printed: the 3-bedroom limit ($42,000) is lower than the 2-bedroom one ($52,000) in both the fact sheet and the form.
